system.description: A grey veil of the Shroud Brethren. Once per day, while wearing it, you may ask a corpse one question, and it answers truthfully in a whisper. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: Lay the veil over a corpse: for 10 minutes the dead speaks freely and truthfully, and it can name its killer even if it never saw them.
system.drawback: The dead keep whispering: Bane on Sanity tests until it is recovered.
